title: Loan originator persists through approval and disbursal (C4649)

source.test: Verify loan originator registration, attachment to loan, and persistence through approval and disbursal

scenario: Register an ACTIVE originator, attach it to a 1000 loan, approve and disburse; the loan must still expose the attached originator afterward.
grade: Assert originator registration status ACTIVE and its attachment survives approval and disbursal.
